arguments.message: Hi! It sounds like your assignment‑notification setting may have been turned off. In the app you can go to **Account → Notifications** and make sure the *Assignment* toggle is on. Push notifications are independent of the other types (mention, status change, digest), so turning those off won’t affect assignment alerts. If the toggle is already on, double‑check your phone’s system‑level notification settings for the Meridian app to ensure push alerts are allowed. Let me know if that restores the alerts!
